supplemental_items.interpretation: Only the detector call is in the catch; IndexError is not included. Unpacking, integer conversion, bound checks and final timestamp access occur outside it. Exact null detector/result yields null pair; valid index uses full main history and recorded event unchanged. The catch includes input price normalization, A confirmation lookup and stop call.
